title: EternalNight MITE
description: A mod to force the world into a eternal night
body:
This is a mod designed to increase the difficulty of the MITE game, the player can modify the configuration file to open the eternal night mode after the first few days. Please always pay attention to your resource inventory ! Live in this vicious world !

**The world is always in the dark**
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c039d059ef568db8998ae7c3da968750b8d7ceb3.png)

You can follow this path: 

**versions\1.6.4-MITE\config\EternalNight.json**

Adjust 'How many days to open the Eternal Night'
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/411d9ad9a8f0ee2010489c373f3156c255eff376.png)
